one_sentence_story: Your brain stores old youth songs in a safe front hub that stays strong even when the name hub fades.
so_what_for_you: Dropping a new name at a party is normal. Save twenty loved songs from your teens now. They build a lifelong bridge for you and your folks.

jargon_map.plain: When a song from your past brings back a vivid place and feeling.
jargon_map.analogy: Like a three-second audio time machine in your car.

jargon_map.plain: A safe front brain zone that keeps old songs safe from harm.
jargon_map.analogy: Like a dry hilltop island standing above a flood.

jargon_map.plain: Songs from ages twelve to twenty-five stick deepest for life.
jargon_map.analogy: Wet cement in youth that sets into solid stone.

jargon_map.plain: Brain zones talking in smooth sync right after a loved song plays.
jargon_map.analogy: Like a whole orchestra tuning up to one clear note.
